purpose: Photoreal masked HISM billboard canopy for the South Fork American River production environment.

assets.generation_brief: Create a photorealistic-natural full mature Sierra foothill ponderosa pine specimen for an Unreal Engine vegetation billboard. Show the entire tree from roots to crown in a straight-on orthographic-like view, with realistic bark, branches, and needle clusters. Isolate it against a perfectly flat #ff00ff magenta chroma background. Use even neutral daylight, no cast shadow, no ground, no scenery, no frame, no text, and no other objects.

Create a distinct photorealistic-natural intermediate-age Sierra foothill ponderosa pine specimen for an Unreal Engine vegetation billboard: complete root-to-crown silhouette, moderately narrow asymmetric crown, orange-brown plated bark, irregular branch whorls, sparse gaps, and muted olive-green needles. Isolate it against a perfectly flat #ff00ff magenta chroma background with neutral overcast light, generous padding, and no shadow, ground, scenery, text, or other objects.
assets.preprocess: Resampled the generated chroma source to 1024x1536 before matte extraction so all three Ponderosa profiles share the same import dimensions.
